title: Dropping the test and leaving play free

captions.physics: Rejecting rules with an unsound foundation
captions.emotions: Meeting the unfamiliar with light interest

meaning: A new shared leisure can stay light when dropping a failed rule leaves both free from immediately finding identical responses.
text: Leisure becomes freer when a mistaken condition can be abandoned. The Tower in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes dismantling a rule that obstructs enjoyment. The Lovers in energy lean towards expecting equal readiness to delight. The Fool in emotions allows light interest in the unfamiliar. A new trial need not produce identical reactions. Two people can enjoy leaving an unworkable scheme without making every following choice another test of whether they are now resting correctly together. Freedom can remain shared even when discoveries differ.

For example, a walk requires you to photograph only the same details. Gradually, the rule clearly prevents individual discoveries. **Shared play permits different discoveries after the test is abandoned.** You can drop the condition and show each other what you find. A sign delights one, an odd shadow the other. Exchanged attention keeps the route shared even if no further image matches. Lightness comes through offering, beyond compulsory identical enthusiasm.

The difficulty is seeking another guarantee of unity after the scheme breaks. Rules, compared photographs and correct reactions return. Surprise becomes permissible only within another test. Curiosity needs living participation. Different responses or an earlier ending can preserve the meeting’s value. A new experience need not establish faultless agreement of wishes to become a genuine pleasure freely chosen and actually lived by both today.
